= Food page 404s = 
* Does not work: https://dwarffortresswiki.org/index.php/Food  
* This works: https://www.dwarffortresswiki.org/index.php/Food  
* This works: https://dwarffortresswiki.org/index.php?title=Food  
* This works: https://dwarffortresswiki.org/index.php/Hunger  

Clicking on the first Food link 404s, but clicking on Hunger redirects to Food without a 404 (with the URL that will 404 if Back/Forward navigate to it!).
